jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

**Job Summary**


As a Senior Product Associate in Digital Acquisition and Enablement Platforms, you contribute to the team by leveraging your expertise in product development and optimization to make a significant impact, supported by user research and customer feedback to fuel the creation of innovative products and continuously improve existing offerings. Collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams and play a crucial role in shaping the future of our products and ongoing success.


**Job responsibilities**


* Partners with the Product Manager to identify new opportunities that reflect the needs of our customers.
* Considers and plans for upstream and downstream implications of new product features on the overall product experience
* Supports the collection of research, journey mapping, and market analysis to inform the strategic product roadmap and provide insight on potential product features that provide value to customers
* Analyzes, tracks, and evaluates product metrics including work to time, cost, and quality targets across the product development life cycle
* Writes the requirements, epics, and user stories to support product development
* Management of backlog of engineering solutions to improve the stability and resiliency of production and non\-production environments
* Delivery of engineering best practices and solutions across a large product group
* Champion engineering best practices, site reliability engineering culture, and automated testing practices in production and non\-production environments
* Enforce governance standards to ensure optimal hygiene practices for applications

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**


* 6\+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in product management or a relevant domain area
* Proficient knowledge of the product development life cycle
* Experience in product life cycle activities including discovery and requirements definition
* Highly motivated self\-starter who thrives in a fast\-paced environment, demonstrates excellent problem\-solving, time management and planning skills, and possesses the ability to handle multiple assignments at the same time. Positive attitude and easy to work with while delivering on high priority, time sensitive initiatives
* Expertise in site reliability engineering practices
* Expertise in continuous integration/continuous delivery methodologies and in automated testing integrated within a development pipeline
* Experience in delivery of engineering best practices and solutions across a large product group
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* In\-depth knowledge of Agile process and principles, including use of Agile project management tools (i.e., Confluence, JIRA/JIRA Align, etc.)

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**


* Demonstrated prior experience working in a highly matrixed, complex organization
* Expertise in observability such as white and black box monitoring, SLO alerting, and telemetry collection using tools such as Grafana, Dynatrace, Datadog, Splunk, etc.
* Expertise with automated testing including, but not limited to, unit, component, contract, end to end, and production testing
* Demonstrated experience with AI tools

**ABOUT US**  

  

  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  

  

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  

  

  

**ABOUT THE TEAM**  

  

  

Our Consumer \& Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most\-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.  

  

The Digital team is dedicated to creating innovative, industry\-leading products and experiences that help customers access, share and control their financial data so they can make smart decisions with their money. Teams enable innovation while adhering to the firm's data sharing principles of security, customer control and convenience, and privacy.

**Your opportunity**
--------------------

 **Schwab Description**


At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we championclient’sgoals with passion and integrity. Guided by honesty, mutualrespectand a commitment to doingwhat’sright, we bring innovation, education, and service together to help shape financial futures. Joining us means becoming part of a global team where your work matters and your future can take shape.

Our Hyderabad location is central to Schwab’s growth, bringing together talented people and technology to drive innovation,scaleand efficiency. Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. The work you do is more than daily operations \-it’sa chance to experiment, learn, and build within avalues\-driven, supportive environment. This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region.

This role builds and enhances the technology stack supporting Billing and Invoicing capabilities across Schwab products and services. * Design, develop, and deliver solutions as part of an Agile Scrum team.

* Use automated test tools and frameworks to support high\-quality software delivery.
* Drive low\-level design of components and libraries for business use cases.
* Support productionreleasemigration and proactively manage risks, documentation, and code quality standards.

**Required Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, related degree, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8\+yearsdeveloping large\-scale software solutions using C\#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, cloud\-enabled technologies, and RESTful APIs.
* 5\+ years working with containers, microservices, backend development, CI/CD, and automated testing.
* 5\+ years with NoSQL and relational databases such as MongoDB, Aerospike, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server.
* 5\+ years with event\-driven architectures or messaging platforms such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar.

* Agilemethodologyexperience,strong communication, solution discovery, collaboration, problem solving, mentoring, and integrity.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3\+ years with private and public cloud platforms such as PCF, GCP, or AWS.
* 2\+ years of IT transformation and modernization experience from legacy to distributed platforms.

At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. * 2\-5 years’ experience designing and developing new or maintaining existing software applications in a software product development environment

* T\-SQL competency: can write multi\-table UPDATEs with proper joins, read and debug stored procedures, and use SSMS confidently

* Practical experience with SDLC and Agile methodologies
* Highly motivated self\-starter with a desire to help others and take action
* Requires strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into non\-technical terms
* Ability to independently work as a contributing member in a high\-paced and focused team
* Ability to multi\-task and prioritize tasks with competing deadlines
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills with the ability to work under pressure
* Ability to socialize ideas and influence decisions without direct authority
* Collaborative in nature with a strong desire to dig in and learn independently and as well as through asking questions
* Considers ‘best\-practice’ standards, as well as departmental policies and procedures
* Computer science fundamentals: OOP, design patterns, data structures \& algorithms

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience on a legacy codebase supporting production customers — not just greenfield work
* Prior exposure to ERP, field\-service, fuel/propane/HVAC, or distribution\-industry software

### **Behavioral Competencies:**


* Cultivates Innovation
* Decision Quality
* Manages Complexity
* Drives Results
* Business Insight

This includes a competitive salary, market\-competitive benefits, and a quarterly perks program. We encourage a good work\-life balance with ample time off \[time away] and, where appropriate, hybrid working arrangements. Employees have access to continuous learning, professional certifications, and leadership development opportunities. Our global culture fosters diversity, inclusion, and values authenticity, trust, curiosity, and diversity of thought, ensuring a supportive environment for all.

jobs.title: UX Engineer, Principal
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Principal UX Researcher to help us empower giving across the world by building deep understanding of a diverse audience — enterprise non\-profits, small charities, individual fundraisers, and donors — and of the increasingly AI\-mediated ways they work. You will identify research opportunities and drive strategic research within a capability or solution, adapt and combine methods to answer complex and longer\-term questions, and partner with UX leadership on the direction of key initiatives.


As AI becomes embedded in our products — from assistive experiences to more automated workflows — understanding how people perceive, trust, adopt, and are affected by intelligent systems is central to this role. You will lead research that explains not just what users need, but how they experience and respond to intelligent, probabilistic systems, helping teams design AI that is trustworthy and genuinely useful. We are looking for someone who is self\-directed, mentors others generously, and drives systematic improvements that raise the quality and impact of research.

**What you'll do**
==================

* Identify research opportunities and drive strategic research within a capability or solution, coordinating the activities of other researchers or designers where needed.

**What you'll bring**

* Extensive user research experience, with a track record of driving strategic research within a product, capability, or solution area.
* Mastery of a wide variety of qualitative methods, and fluency with inferential statistics and quantitative research methods.
* **Experience researching AI or intelligent systems** and a practical understanding of how AI behaviours affect user trust, comprehension, adoption, and outcomes. Familiarity with responsible AI considerations such as bias, transparency, and over\-reliance is a plus.

* Excellent communication, presentation, and writing skills, with insight\-driven storytelling tailored to any audience.

jobs.description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**

  

At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.

  

Join us as we create something extraordinary together.

**Level:** Senior Individual Contributor  

**Organization:** Product Management / Strategic Data  

**Reports to:** Director or VP, Product Management

 **Role Overview**


LPL Financial is seeking a **Data** **Product Analyst** to support our **Strategic Data Platforms**, with a strong focus on how data is produced, shaped, governed, and delivered to downstream consumers across the firm.


This role sits at the intersection of **Product Management, Data Product Ownership, and Advanced Analysis**, and is designed for a senior individual contributor who can bring rigor and clarity to complex, data‑centric platform initiatives.


The Data Product Analyst focuses on **data as a product**—helping define data contracts, validate quality, assess downstream impact, and support data product and platform decisions.


The ideal candidate is comfortable working across **upstream systems of record, platform services, and downstream consumers**, and excels at turning complex data flows into actionable insights and decisions.

 **Key Responsibilities**

**Product Discovery \& Capability Support**

* Support product discovery by helping translate business and platform needs into **clear data‑centric problem statements**.
* Contribute to roadmap planning by evaluating **value, risk, and complexity** across data initiatives.
* Help define **outcomes and success measures** for data platform capabilities (e.g., usability, reliability, adoption, quality).
**Advanced Data Analysis \& Problem Solving**

* Perform hands‑on exploratory and diagnostic analysis across distributed data sources and platforms.
* Investigate data quality issues, lineage gaps, and semantic inconsistencies that affect downstream consumers.
* Conduct impact analysis for schema changes, new feeds, platform migrations, or system decommissions.
* Identify systemic issues in data flow, transformation, or consumption and recommend durable solutions.
**Data Product Ownership (Supporting / Platform‑Level)**

* Support Data Product Owners by helping define:
* Data contracts, schemas, and semantic definitions
* Data quality rules, validation logic, and controls
* Usage expectations and downstream dependencies
* Maintain traceability between **business intent, data products, and technical implementation**.
* Partner with engineering, architecture, and data platform teams to support scalable, reusable distribution patterns.
**Agile Execution \& Delivery**

* Contribute to Jira artifacts (features, stories, acceptance criteria) with strong data and platform context.
* Participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning, and demos to ensure work reflects validated platform and consumer needs.
* Support prioritization decisions by providing **evidence‑based impact and dependency analysis**.
**Stakeholder Communication \& Influence**

* Act as an analytical partner to Product Managers, Platform Owners, Engineering, and downstream consumer teams.
* Communicate complex data flow and platform concepts in **clear, decision‑ready narratives**.
* Help align stakeholders across domains by grounding conversations in data realities and trade‑offs.
 **Required Qualifications**

* 5\+ years of experience in **Product Analytics, Data Analysis, Data Product Ownership, or Platform‑oriented Product roles**.
* Strong hands‑on experience with SQL (advanced querying, joins, performance awareness)
* Experience working with **data platforms, distributed data systems, or integration layers**.
* Experience adopting emerging AI‑enabled capabilities to improve the speed, depth, and effectiveness of data analysis
* Experience operating in **Agile/Scrum environments** with cross‑functional product and engineering teams.
* Proven ability to work across ambiguity and translate complex data ecosystems into actionable insights.
* Solid understanding of:
* Data modeling and semantic consistency
* Data quality, lineage, and governance concepts
* Pipelines, and event‑driven architectures (conceptual and analytical understanding)
 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting advisor data platforms, or shared enterprise data services.
* Familiarity with **downstream consumer needs** (applications, analytics platforms, partners, regulatory consumers).
* Experience performing **impact analysis for data changes** across multiple consuming systems.
* Background in financial services, wealth management, or other highly regulated data environments.
 **What Success Looks Like**

* Data platform decisions are made with **clear understanding of downstream impact and value**.
* Platform teams have strong analytical support when defining and evolving shared data capabilities.
* Data quality and semantic issues are identified early, before they impact consumers.
 **Why This Role Matters**


As LPL continues to scale its data platforms, success depends on more than moving data—it depends on **clarity, trust, and usability**. This role ensures that data products are well‑defined, well‑understood, and fit for purpose, enabling faster innovation and better outcomes for advisors and clients.


LPL Global Business Services, LLP \- PRIVACY POLICY

jobs.title: Product Ops Manager- Sustainability Services, EU Marketplace
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


The Amazon Marketplace is a critical part of the Amazon ecosystem which offers millions of sellers the opportunity to build and grow their business using Amazon’s reach and expertise. Sellers are a critical part of Amazon’s ecosystem to deliver on our vision of offering the Earth’s largest selection and lowest prices. In our vision to build a global marketplace, we will enable Sellers to list, make their selection available to customers globally while optimizing their inventory placement across multiple countries.  

  

EPR Services on Amazon aims to dramatically transform the way Sellers can fulfil their Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) compliance obligations in the EU, in order to keep selling on Amazon. EPR is an environmental policy that makes Sellers who first places a product subject to EPR requirements in a country responsible for the entire life cycle of the products that they introduce on the market, from their design until the end of life.
  

  

As a Product Ops Manager on the Pay on Behalf team, you will help us set up the product operations needed to ensure compliance reporting and payments for our Sellers. The role will involve working with product, tech, business, legal, compliance authorities and fees stakeholders.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Design, implement, and own mechanisms to monitor seller journey and interaction with our product to ensure delivery on metrics, goals, and team projects.
* Work closely with product team and key stakeholders to conceptualize and implement key features and processes for improving seller experience and achieving business goals.
* Actively seek ways to improve product related process efficiencies and effectiveness.
* Proactively identify gaps or blockers to seller experience, propose solutions, and drive implementation across partner teams.
* Communicate updates on key strategic programs and metrics to leaders and stakeholders
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

jobs.title: Product Lead - Opterra - Treasury
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
 Arcesium is a global financial technology firm that solves complex data\-driven challenges faced by some of the world’s most sophisticated financial institutions. We constantly innovate our platform and capabilities to meet tomorrow’s challenges, anticipate the risks our clients encounter, and design advanced solutions to help our clients achieve transformational business outcomes.
   

  

 Financial technology is a high\-growth industry as change and innovation continue to disrupt the status\-quo and prompt major transformation. Arcesium is at a particularly interesting time in our own growth as we look to leverage our successfully established market position and expand operations in pursuit of strategic new business opportunities. We value intellectual curiosity, proactive ownership, and collaboration with colleagues, and we empower you to meaningfully contribute from day one and accelerate your professional development.
   

  

 We are looking for a passionate and technically adept Product Lead to join the Treasury group within the Product Management team. The Treasury product portfolio covers critical post\-trade functions including collateral management, margin calculation, portfolio financing, and securities borrowing and lending. This group works with technology teams throughout the process lifecycle to specify, develop, and implement Arcesium’s treasury modules.
   

  

 This role offers the opportunity to define and design the next generation of treasury products on a platform used by some of the most sophisticated hedge funds and institutional asset managers in the world, and to collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Own the product vision, roadmap, and execution for Arcesium’s treasury product modules, focusing on delivering robust, scalable solutions for collateral management, margin, portfolio financing, and securities borrow/lend workflows.
* Rapidly prototype product ideas and validate hypotheses using AI tools and vibe\-coding techniques—building functional prototypes hands\-on to accelerate discovery, test feasibility, and communicate product intent to engineering and stakeholders.
* Distill the vision into product roadmap and product/feature specifications through requirement gathering, solutioning, and business analysis in close partnership with clients and internal stakeholders.
* Collaborate closely with engineers and architects to translate product specifications into design and eventual product, ensuring core capabilities are effectively implemented and continuously improved.
* Rigorously and continuously evaluate the progress of products and features in flight by leveraging test cases and ensuring compliance with product specifications and the overall vision.
* Engage with both internal stakeholders and external users at client organizations to gather feedback, identify pain points, and prioritize impactful product improvements.
* Measure and analyze product usage data and user feedback to guide roadmap priorities and inform investment decisions.
* Conduct market research and competitive landscape analysis to stay ahead of industry trends in treasury and post\-trade technology.
* Articulate business cases, estimate timelines and budgets, and communicate with all stakeholders; prepare project plans, release notes, and other artifacts.
* Partner with product managers across other product groups on cross\-cutting programs and initiatives to provide comprehensive business solutions.


**What You’ll Need**
* 6\+ years of overall work experience, with a minimum of 2 years in product management preferably for financial technology products or platforms.
* Hands\-on experience using AI coding assistants and vibe\-coding / rapid\-prototyping approaches to build working product prototypes. You should be comfortable going from idea to interactive demo without waiting for engineering.
* Customer empathy and a deep understanding of client needs, preferably with experience working directly with hedge funds or institutional asset managers.
* Adept at balancing technical requirements with user and stakeholder needs, both internally and at enterprise client organizations.
* Experience working closely with engineering teams in an agile software development environment.
* Outstanding academic background and a passion to work in a high\-tech software development environment.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
* Critical thinking and the ability to articulate standpoints and ideas and influence stakeholders.
* Ability to multitask and manage multiple lines of execution with attention to detail and quality.
* A high level of personal maturity and a collaborative attitude.
* A healthy combination of resourcefulness, domain expertise, creativity, and execution prowess.
* Domain expertise in treasury and post\-trade processes such as collateral management, margin calculation, portfolio financing, securities borrow/lend, or related middle\- and back\-office functions, is optional but nice to have.


 Arcesium's Personal Data Privacy Notice for Candidates is linked here.
   

  

**Recruiting Security**
 Emails from genuine Arcesium recruiters who are employees of the company will always come from the @arcesium.com domain. In some cases, you may also be contacted by independent search firms engaged to recruit on our behalf; emails from their employees should always come from their firm's applicable domain. If something seems off or you're contacted by an unexpected third party, please reach out to us at careers@arcesium.com (US/UK), careers\-india@arcesium.com (India) or careers\-europe@arcesium.com (Portugal/Sweden).

jobs.description:
**This role is for one of our clients**
  

Company Name: ADOSX Tech
Industry: Software Development  


Seniority level: Mid\-Senior level  



Experience: 8\+ yrs



Location: Hyderabad, Telangana, India



Job Type: Full\-time



**The Role**
------------



As the first full\-time technical leader at ADOSX, you will build the foundations that future teams inherit. You'll work directly with founders and the CTO to define the platform, engineering culture, and technical standards for an AI\-native automotive operating system.



On a four\-person team, that means setting architecture and writing the load\-bearing code. This is a hands\-on leadership role—not a manager who delegates difficult problems.



You own the parts of the system where mistakes are expensive or irreversible:


* The data reconciliation engine that powers core workflows.
* The AI grounding layer that must never invent business numbers.
* The integrations that bring dealership data into the platform.
* Multi\-tenant isolation, security, and auditability.
* The standards for AI\-native software development.


You'll spend time inside dealerships, work closely with customers, and build systems grounded in operational reality—not assumptions.



Over time, you'll help shape engineering culture, support technical hiring, and grow into broader leadership responsibilities as the team scales.


**What You'll Own**
-------------------


### **Data Access \& Integrations**


* Build lawful, reliable, and version\-stable mechanisms to extract data from existing systems.
* Work with customers and upstream system owners to solve integration challenges.
* Handle heterogeneous schemas and data formats.
* Create configuration\-driven onboarding instead of code\-driven implementations.

### **The Reconciliation Engine**


* Design confidence\-based reconciliation across multiple source systems.
* Detect confidently wrong matches—not just unmatched records.
* Own exception handling, auditing, and measurable accuracy.

### **The AI Grounding Layer**


* Build constrained\-query systems over free\-form generation.
* Implement RAG, trace enforcement, and explainable outputs.
* Ensure every business number is verifiable.
* Treat "I can't answer that" as a feature, not a failure.


### **Multi\-Tenant Foundations**


* PostgreSQL Row\-Level Security as the primary isolation mechanism.
* Cross\-tenant leakage testing in CI.
* RBAC, audit trails, and data\-protection foundations.

### **Event\-Driven Architecture**


* Celery\-based event flows.
* Canonical data models.
* Configurable integration patterns that keep onboarding a new dealer are a matter of configuration, not code.

### **AI\-Native Engineering Practices**


* Define how the team uses AI coding agents.
* Establish review standards and guardrails for AI\-generated code.
* Increase engineering leverage without compromising quality, correctness, or security.

### **Technical Leadership**


* Set conventions for code structure, API design, and testing.
* Support junior engineers in owning features end\-to\-end.
* Help shape engineering culture and future hiring practices.

### **What We're Looking For**


* Around 8 years of experience building production systems.
* Deep expertise in Python, Django, DRF, Celery, and PostgreSQL.
* Experience managing ORM migrations under changing schemas.
* Strong experience integrating messy external systems and reconciling data.
* Practical LLM and RAG experience, with healthy skepticism toward model outputs.
* PostgreSQL depth, including Row\-Level Security, performance optimization, and multi\-tenant patterns.
* Pragmatic thinking about scale—knowing when a modular monolith and simple queues are the right choices.
* Experience building with AI coding agents and establishing a team around them.
* The judgment to challenge unrealistic timelines, scope, or technical assumptions.

### **Nice to Have**


* Fintech\-grade or data\-heavy reconciliation systems.
* Enterprise or legacy system integrations.
* Familiarity with ISO 27001, DPDPA, or related security practices.
* Working knowledge of Next.js and React.


### **You'll Thrive Here If**


* You love ambiguity more than certainty.
* You prefer ownership over instructions.
* You think in systems, not tickets.
* You enjoy getting your hands dirty with customers.
* You learn by building rather than waiting.
* You use AI as leverage, not as a substitute for judgment.

You want both the 0 1 and 1* 100 journeys.

### **The Hard Truth**



Early\-stage startups are hard. There will be ambiguity, changing priorities, and periods of intense execution because building from zero demands it.



But you'll own products end\-to\-end, work directly with founders and customers, and likely learn more in two years than many engineers do in ten.  

  

If building the intelligence layer for Indian automotive retail excites you more than maintaining systems someone else designed, we'd love to build ADOSX together.



**About the company**
---------------------


ADOSX is building an AI\-native operating system for automotive retail, combining agentic workflows, unified data, and real\-time intelligence to help dealerships operate smarter and more profitably. Backed by strategic investors, we're redefining auto\-tech from India.
**Must\-have skills**
---------------------


System Architecture, LLM Guardrail, Data Pipelines
**Good\-to\-have skills**
-------------------------


Stakeholder Management, Project Planning, Domain Translation

jobs.description:
**Role Overview**
 The Procurement \& Asset Analyst manages the procurement and lifecycle of the client's physical and digital assets — hardware purchasing, purchase\-order processing, global asset lifecycle operations, asset administration and New Product Introduction (NPI) support. At roughly 673 transactions per month, the role is the hardware\-procurement engine that feeds the receiving and deployment work Astreya already performs downstream, making clean, accurate POs and asset records essential to the wider operation.
   

  

 The analyst creates and amends purchase orders — including special, replenishment and urgent POs — sources new products, manages asset records and part numbers across the lifecycle, and supports NPI from RFQ through to system\-ID creation. The role reports to the Procurement \& Asset Team Lead and partners closely with Supplier \& Vendor Management and the SAM team to keep master data and supplier information consistent.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Hardware Procurement \& Purchase Orders
* Manage the purchasing process for IT hardware, peripherals, and professional services from initial request validation through to purchase requisition (PR) submission and supplier confirmation.
* Create, amend and expedite purchase orders — special, replenishment and urgent — ensuring each PO is complete, correctly priced and properly approved.
* Source new products and run the purchase\-order process end\-to\-end, from requisition to PO issue and confirmation.
* Uphold PO accuracy and meet creation, amendment and urgent\-order turnaround targets, since errors here ripple into receiving and invoicing.
* Triage and resolve automated purchase order pricing and quantity discrepancies via designated escalation paths (e.g., line\-item cancellations vs. quantity revisions).
* Process urgent or exception\-driven manual requisitions in the procurement platform. Apply strict system tracking tags in external reference fields to preserve downstream automated three\-way matching and prevent invoicing holds.
* Draft and update BPO creation logic, incorporate demand forecasts, and manage BPO uplifts when utilization hits critical thresholds.
* Manage Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) workflows directly with suppliers to resolve damaged or incorrect deliveries.
* Global Asset Lifecycle Operations
* Manage the asset lifecycle — creating part numbers, assigning assets and keeping records updated through moves, reassignments and retirements.
* Maintain accurate asset and master\-data records so that asset, procurement and finance systems stay reconciled.
* Perform bulk data updates (including MAC addresses, serial numbers, locations, and project codes) to maintain hardware master data integrity within the database.
* Coordinate part number creation, submit trade classification requests (HTS/ECCN), secure customs valuations, and coordinate regional catalog rollouts.
* Coordinate MPN and asset reassignments in the database backend to transfer assets cleanly from source MIDs to target MIDs.
* Asset Administration Services
* Administer entries in the asset administration system — creating, editing and activating or deactivating offerings — so the available catalog stays current and correct.
* Validate prepayment terms against threshold criteria and coordinate internal cost\-reallocation (chargeback) ledgers.
* Process inter\-departmental chargeback requests by validating mandatory corporate fields (requester, cost centers, location, task numbers), entering verified data into reallocation templates, and coordinating with invoicing teams.
* New Product Introduction (NPI) Support
* Track NPI requests through the pipeline, submit RFQs to suppliers and create the system IDs needed to transact new products.
* Coordinate with catalog and engineering teams during product launches to set up the correct Base\-and\-Variant MID hierarchy, establishing regional variant entries under active parent items.
* Facilitate international shipments by initiating part compliance steps (New Part Requests, trade classifications, and customs valuations) in Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) tools, ensuring parts are pre\-cleared before transit.


 PERFORMANCE \& SERVICE LEVELS
   

  

 Indicative performance targets for the role; final service levels are confirmed on engagement and measured by location per service line.
   

  

* Purchase Request Accuracy: keep ≥99% of purchase requests error\-free before PO\-owner approval — correct specifications, quantities, pricing and required inputs.
* PR / PO Creation Turnaround: create ≥95% of standard requisitions within 2 business days of a complete, approved request.
* Urgent PR / PO Creation: create ≥99% of urgent requisitions within 4 hours, so time\-critical needs are not held up.
* PR / PO Amendment \& Change Orders: process ≥95% of amendments within 1 business day, and communicate approved PO changes within ≤2 days.
* Maintain a triage SLA of 3 hours to acknowledge new procurement requests.
* Maintain ≥99% data accuracy on all hardware, pricing, and tax classification fields.
* Documentation Completeness \& Knowledge Management: keep a current directory of process documentation with revision dates and contribute to the shared knowledge base, so SOPs stay accurate and reusable.
* Perform follow\-up actions and update statuses on all open catalog or exception tickets every 3 days.


 TOOLS \& SYSTEMS
   

  

* SAP (Procure\-to\-Pay / Materials Management) for POs and asset records; the procurement platform for purchasing; and IBP for planning inputs to procurement and asset flows.
* Systems for managing part numbers and engineering workflows.
* Enterprise guided buying networks, internal ordering portals, and catalog administration consoles.
* Integrated business ticketing systems and internal messaging platforms.

jobs.description:
At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion client’s goals with passion and integrity. Guided by honesty, mutual respect and a commitment to doing what’s right, we bring innovation, education, and service together to help shape financial futures. Our people are the foundation of our success – they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. As we expand into India, we are bringing this same culture of inclusion, learning, and opportunity to new talent.
 



  





**Role Description\-** 




 As a Technical Business Analyst, you will serve as a key liaison between Product Owners, Business Analyst, Architects and Engineering teams. You will be responsible for translating business needs into well\-defined technical requirements, managing agile team backlogs, facilitating Scrum ceremonies, and ensuring successful delivery of technology solutions. This role requires a blend of business analysis, data analysis, technical acumen, agile leadership and reporting, and stakeholder management skills.
 



  





 You will work closely with cross\-functional teams to define solutions, clarify requirements, remove impediments, and drive execution while ensuring alignment with platform strategy and business objectives
 



  





**Required Skills :\-** 




 • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
 



 • 5\+ years of experience as a Technical Analyst, Business Systems Analyst, Technical Product Analyst, Scrum Master, or similar role supporting software development teams.
 



 • Strong understanding of Agile, Scrum, and SDLC methodologies.
 



 • Experience managing product backlogs and translating business requirements into technical user stories.
 



 • Hands\-on experience with reporting and visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent BI platforms.

 • Working knowledge of MongoDB or other NoSQL databases, including ability to query, filter, aggregate, and interpret semi\-structured data.
 



 • Ability to facilitate discussions across business and technical teams and drive consensus.
 



 • Experience creating process flows, system diagrams, use cases, data mappings, and functional specifications.
 



 • Working knowledge of APIs, microservices, databases, cloud technologies, and modern application architectures.
 



 • Experience working with tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, GitHub, or similar Agile delivery platforms.
 



  





**Preferred Skills :\-** 




 Financial services or fintech industry experience.
 



 • Experience supporting enterprise platforms, workflow systems, orchestration solutions, or operational automation initiatives.
 



 • Experience with SQL, data analysis, reporting, and business intelligence tools.
 



 • Familiarity with AI\-assisted development and productivity tools, including Microsoft Copilot.
 



 • Understanding of data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, data marts, and reporting layers.
 



 • Experience with MongoDB aggregation pipelines, JSON data structures, and event\-based data analysis.

 • SAFe, Scrum Master, Product Owner, or Business Analysis certifications.
 



 • Knowledge of cloud platforms and modern engineering practices such as CI/CD, DevOps, Infrastructure as Code, and Test\-Driven Development.

Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.

Cloud Infrastructure: Hands\-on AWS experience (Lambda, ECS, API Gateway, RDS).

jobs.title: Technical Team Leader - DevOps & DevSecOps
jobs.description:
**Company Description**
-----------------------


Engineering the AI\-powered enterprise. With AI and cloud\-native solutions, BETSOL accelerates cloud transformation for enterprises across 17\+ countries. BETSOL holds several engineering patents, and is recognized with industry awards. BETSOL maintains a net promoter score that is 2x the industry average.


BETSOL’s open source backup and recovery product line, Zmanda (Zmanda.com), delivers up to 50% savings in total cost of ownership (TCO) and delivers best\-in\-class performance.


BETSOL Global IT Services (BETSOL.com) builds and supports end\-to\-end enterprise solutions, reducing time\-to\-market for customers.


We take pride in being an employee\-centric organization, offering comprehensive benefits and opportunities.


Learn more at betsol.com

**Job Description**
-------------------


You will lead a technical pod of full\-stack DevOps/DevSecOps engineers while staying hands\-on in the code, the architecture, and the pipelines. This is a player\-coach role: you set technical direction across the stack, run design and code reviews, unblock the team, and double as the project manager for the engagement. You are the single point of accountability for what the pod ships and how it ships.

**Responsibilities**

**Technical Leadership**

* **Own end\-to\-end architecture across infrastructure, CI/CD, and application layers for cloud portal workloads on Azure and GCP.**
* **Drive systems\-level design: trade\-off analysis, reference architectures, reusable Terraform/Ansible/Helm patterns, and platform conventions the team builds against.**
* Run code reviews and design reviews. Set the quality bar and the definition of done.
* Stay hands\-on: contribute IaC modules, pipeline logic, and application code as needed. Expect to spend roughly 80% of your time on technical contributions and 20% on team management.
* Champion AI\-first development practices across the pod: model\-assisted coding, prompt and context discipline, agentic workflows in IDEs and CI, and review of AI\-generated output for security and correctness.

**Delivery \& Project Management**

* Run the pod as project manager: sprint planning, standups, retrospectives, status reporting to BETSOL and client stakeholders.
* Maintain the backlog, sequence work against client priorities, and surface risks early.
* Lead release management, change control, and post\-incident reviews.
* Forecast capacity as the pod scales from 2\-3 to 5\-6 engineers and partner with BETSOL on hiring loops for added seats.

**People \& Mentorship**

* Onboard new engineers, set growth paths, and provide regular one\-on\-one technical coaching.
* Build a culture of ownership, transparent communication, and continuous learning.

**DevSecOps Governance**

* Embed security, compliance (FedRAMP, FIPS, CIS, ISO, PCI), and observability standards into every delivery the pod produces.
* Partner with client security teams on threat modeling and audit response.**Looking For**


8\+ years in software engineering or platform engineering, with at least 2 years leading a delivery team of 3\+ engineers. Hands\-on coding within the last 12 months is required.

**Mandatory Skills**

**A. Technical**
* Proven experience as technical architect or technical lead
* Deep cloud architecture experience on any of the following: **Azure (preferred), AWS, or GCP** (AKS/GKE, App Gateway, VNets, NSGs, Key Vault, Managed Identities, IAM, networking).
* Strong with **Terraform, Helm, Kubernetes**, and reusable module design.

 At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

* Internal developer platform or platform\-as\-a\-product experience

jobs.description:
**Title:** 
 Product Owner Data and Integrations
   

  

**Location** 
 : Bangalore/Pune, India
   

  

**Overview:** 
 Johnson Controls is seeking an experienced and business\-focused Product Owner to lead the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of data and integrations teams for an enterprise eCommerce application. This role will serve as the bridge between business stakeholders, technology teams, data engineering, architecture, and external partners to translate business needs into scalable data flows, APIs, integration requirements, and prioritized product backlogs. The Product Owner will drive outcomes that improve data quality, system interoperability, operational efficiency, and user adoption while ensuring solutions meet security, governance, performance, and compliance expectations. The role requires techno\-functional skills to analyze data, write SQLs, create and update field mappings, and debug issues with cross\-platform teams.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own and maintain the product vision, roadmap, and prioritized backlog for data and integrations teams.
* Be the SME for APIs, and data process flows.
* Partner with business stakeholders to understand objectives, pain points, reporting needs, process gaps, and integration requirements, translating them into clear user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Collaborate with data engineering, application development, architecture, security, and QA teams to design and deliver scalable, reliable, and secure data and integration solutions.
* Ensure data quality, lineage, governance, privacy, and compliance considerations are embedded into product requirements and delivery decisions.
* Manage sprint planning, backlog refinement, release planning, demos, and stakeholder reviews in alignment with Agile delivery practices.
* Evaluate technical feasibility, business value, risk, and dependency impacts when prioritizing features, enhancements, defects, and technical debt.
* Work with teams to establish performance, reliability, monitoring, and support expectations for data pipelines, APIs, and integration services.
* Support user acceptance testing by validating that delivered capabilities meet business objectives, functional requirements, and defined acceptance criteria.
* Coordinate cross\-functional dependencies across internal teams, external vendors, and enterprise platforms to ensure successful end\-to\-end delivery.
* Communicate product status, roadmap priorities, delivery risks, decisions, and outcomes clearly to stakeholders and leadership.
* Drive adoption and continuous improvement by gathering feedback, monitoring usage, measuring product success, and identifying opportunities to enhance data and integration capabilities.


**Qualifications**
* 6\-8 years of experience in product ownership, business analysis, solution delivery, data platforms, integrations, or enterprise application delivery.
* Demonstrated experience defining product roadmaps, managing backlogs, writing user stories, and prioritizing work based on business value, technical feasibility, and stakeholder impact.
* Functional understanding of APIs and data integration concepts, including APIs, ETL/ELT, data pipelines, batch and real\-time processing, data mapping, and system interoperability.
* Experience working with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, ERP, CRM, data warehouses, data lakes, middleware, iPaaS, or integration platforms.
* Ability to translate complex business processes and data needs into clear functional and technical requirements for engineering and delivery teams.
* Familiarity with data governance, data quality, data privacy, master data management, lineage, security, and compliance considerations.
* Experience working in Agile Scrum teams, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, demos, retrospectives, and release planning.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with business users, technical teams, vendors, architects, QA teams, and leadership.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain data and integration concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Analytical mindset with strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to balance strategic product direction with day\-to\-day delivery decisions.
* Experience with product management and delivery tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, or similar platforms.
* Knowledge of cloud data platforms, API management, event streaming, middleware, or modern integration architecture is preferred.
* Relevant certifications such as Certified Scrum Product Owner, SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager, Salesforce, cloud, data, or integration certifications are preferred.

jobs.description:
**Product Manager : Consumer Experience** 




  





**We’re looking for a Product Manager who turns customer understanding into shipped outcomes.** 




 MyYogaTeacher helps people across the world improve their health and well being through live, personalized yoga. We connect students with experienced yoga teachers in India for 1\-on\-1 sessions designed around their goals, lifestyle, health conditions, and preferences.
 



 Our platform has served 200K\+ customers and supports thousands of live sessions across time zones, devices, payment systems, and customer journeys.
 



 We are now entering a phase where speed, clarity, and execution matter more than ever.
 



 We are looking for a hands\-on Product Manager who can speak with students, understand their real motivations, make sound decisions with incomplete information, and work closely with design, engineering, analytics, sales, and operations to ship meaningful improvements quickly.
 



 This is not a role for someone who only writes requirements, manages Jira, or waits for complete data before making a decision.
 



 You will be expected to understand the customer, form a point of view, bring teams together, and drive the product from problem discovery through execution and measurable impact.
 



  





**What You’ll Own** 




**Customer and Persona Understanding** 



* Develop a deep understanding of our students—their goals, anxieties, motivations, objections, habits, and reasons for choosing personalized yoga.
* Regularly speak with prospective students, active customers, churned customers, teachers, sales teams, and customer support teams.
* Convert customer conversations, behavioral data, support tickets, sales calls, and session feedback into clear product insights.
* Build and continuously refine customer personas and journey maps based on evidence rather than assumptions.
* Understand the underlying job the customer is hiring MyYogaTeacher to do—not merely the feature they are requesting.
* Ensure that product decisions remain connected to why MyYogaTeacher exists: helping people build healthier, happier, and more sustainable lives and identify ambivalence.



  





**Product Discovery and Decision Making** 



* Identify high impact opportunities across acquisition, trial, conversion, onboarding, engagement, retention, referrals, and reactivation.
* Clearly define the customer problem, target persona, expected behavior change, and desired business outcome before proposing a solution.
* Form strong product hypotheses using qualitative insights, product analytics, market understanding, and business context.
* Make thoughtful decisions even when information is incomplete or circumstances are changing.
* Distinguish between decisions that require deeper research and decisions that can be made quickly and reversed later.
* Maintain a clear product decision log so teams understand what was decided, why it was decided, and what assumptions are being tested.
* Challenge weak assumptions, unnecessary complexity, and solutions that do not address the underlying customer problem.



  





**Execution and Delivery** 



* Take end to end ownership of product initiatives from problem discovery to launch, adoption, measurement, and iteration.
* Translate product opportunities into clear requirements, user journeys, success metrics, edge cases, and acceptance criteria.
* Work closely with design and engineering to reduce ambiguity and unblock decisions quickly.
* Break large initiatives into smaller releases that allow the team to learn and deliver customer value sooner.
* Participate actively throughout development instead of handing over requirements and waiting for completion.
* Review product builds continuously, identify gaps early, and ensure that the final experience solves the intended problem.
* Drive weekly execution across multiple product initiatives while maintaining clarity on priorities and outcomes.
* Follow through after launch to measure adoption, identify friction, and improve the product based on actual customer behavior.



  





**Product Analytics and Business Impact** 



* Define measurable outcomes for every major product initiative.
* Use funnel analysis, cohort analysis, customer segmentation, experiment results, and qualitative feedback to understand product performance.
* Monitor key metrics across trial completion, trial\-to\-paid conversion, onboarding, session attendance, engagement, retention, referrals, and customer satisfaction.
* Investigate unexpected changes in customer behavior instead of relying only on dashboard\-level reporting.
* Partner with analytics and engineering teams to improve the quality and usefulness of product data.
* Communicate whether a product initiative worked, what was learned, and what should happen next.



  





**Cross\-Functional Leadership** 



* Bring together engineering, design, analytics, sales, marketing, teacher operations, and customer support around a shared understanding of the customer problem.
* Communicate product decisions clearly and directly across technical and non\-technical teams.
* Resolve ambiguity and disagreements by returning the discussion to customer evidence, strategic priorities, and expected outcomes.
* Conduct product demonstrations and training for teams responsible for launching, selling, supporting, or operating new experiences.
* Ensure that teams understand not only what is being built, but why it matters.
* Take accountability for the outcome without blaming dependencies, processes, or other functions when execution becomes difficult.



  





**AI\-First Product Management** 



* Use AI tools as part of your daily product workflow—not as an occasional experiment.
* Apply AI to accelerate customer research synthesis, product analysis, competitive research, requirement development, prototyping, test\-case thinking, and documentation.

jobs.title: Business Support, Business Intelligence Development
jobs.description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

**Role summary:** Support business decisions by collecting, validating, analyzing, and reporting data. Ensure data accuracy, identify discrepancies/anomalies, and work with stakeholders to deliver clear insights and actionable recommendations.
  
  

**Key responsibilities:**  

Gather data from multiple internal/external sources and document sources used.1
  
Clean, validate, and reconcile datasets; identify missing/incomplete information and resolve inconsistencies.
  
Analyze data to spot trends, issues, and anomalies; escalate discrepancies to the right stakeholders with evidence.
  
Build and maintain dashboards/reports; translate findings into clear summaries for business partners
  
Enter and maintain data in required systems/tools; ensure timely updates and high accuracy.
  
Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to confirm requirements, align definitions, and improve data quality/processes.
  
Maintain audit\-ready documentation and organize supporting materials in shared repositories.
  
  

**Skills and qualifications:**  

Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving; able to interpret moderately complex issues within standard procedures.
  
Strong attention to detail and data quality mindset (validation, reconciliation, anomaly checks).
  
Proficiency with spreadsheets and reporting/BI tools (add your required tools: Excel, Power BI, SQL, etc.).
  
Clear communication—can explain insights to non\-technical stakeholders.
  
Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (or equivalent experience).
  
  

If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:
  
  

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  

About JLL –
  
  

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

jobs.title: Business Analyst, Principal
jobs.description:
### **Alternate Job Titles**

* Anaplan Model Builder, Sales Operations
* Senior Business Analyst, GTM Systems
* Sales Planning Systems Analyst
* Anaplan Solutions Architect, Sales Operations
* GTM Operations Analyst, Anaplan

### **We Are**


Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**


You have spent years turning messy spreadsheets and half\-formed business problems into Anaplan models that actually work, models that scale, that people trust, and that make decisions faster. You know the difference between a model that technically functions and one that a sales ops leader can actually use on a Tuesday morning when comp plans are shifting and quotas need recalculating. You do not just build what you are asked to build. You ask why, you push back when a requirement does not make sense, and you propose a better way forward.


You are comfortable sitting with a GTM leader talking through a sales compensation scenario and walking out with a functional spec that accounts for edge cases they had not even thought of yet. Ambiguity does not slow you down. You work with what you have, fill in the gaps, and move. You have built enough models to know what breaks at scale, and you design around it from the start. At Synopsys, you will shape how a global sales organization plans, compensates, and operates, and the models you build will be used every day by teams across the company.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Build, modify, and maintain Anaplan models for GTM Sales Compensation and Sales Planning use cases across a global sales organization
* Gather and analyze business requirements from sales ops leaders and translate them into functional specs, use cases, and multi\-dimensional Anaplan models
* Migrate existing spreadsheet\-based processes and legacy solutions into scalable Anaplan models that support connected planning
* Lead data integration, UAT testing, and deployment for new models and enhancements, ensuring accuracy and adoption
* Represent GTM Sales Operations in the Anaplan Corporate Center of Excellence, driving alignment and shared best practices across functional areas
* Perform root cause analysis when models or processes break, propose solutions, and implement fixes that prevent recurrence
* Document models, workflows, and business logic so that others can understand, maintain, and build on your work

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Enable faster, more accurate sales compensation calculations and planning cycles for a global GTM organization
* Reduce reliance on manual spreadsheets and fragmented tools, replacing them with connected Anaplan solutions that scale
* Improve visibility and decision\-making for sales leadership by building models that surface the right data at the right time
* Drive adoption of Anaplan best practices across GTM and influence how connected planning evolves company\-wide
* Support strategic sales planning initiatives that directly affect revenue operations and quota management
* Accelerate deployment timelines by translating business needs into working models without endless back\-and\-forth
* Build a foundation for future GTM automation and digital transformation initiatives

### **What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Information Systems, or a related field
* 5\+ years of experience in Sales Operations or FP\&A, with hands\-on Anaplan model building experience
* Anaplan Model Builder Level 3 certification
* Proven experience building Anaplan models for Sales Compensation use cases is a strong plus
* Advanced Excel skills and financial modeling experience, you know how to structure data and logic that scales
* Willingness to work partially during US time zone hours to collaborate with global stakeholders
* Strong understanding of sales operations processes, including territory planning, quota management, and comp plan design

### **Who You Are**

* You can take a vague business problem and turn it into a clear functional spec without needing perfect information upfront
* You explain technical tradeoffs to non\-technical stakeholders in plain language, no jargon, no hand\-waving
* You catch modeling errors before they go live because you test your own work and think through edge cases others miss
* You push back when a request does not align with best practices, and you offer a better path forward instead of just saying no
* You stay organized across multiple workstreams, deadlines, and stakeholders without dropping threads or losing context
* You are comfortable being the Anaplan expert in the room and the person others come to when something is not working

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**


You will join the GTM Sales Operations team, working closely with sales leadership, compensation analysts, and planning teams to build the systems that power how Synopsys plans and pays its global sales organization. You will also represent this team in the Anaplan Corporate Center of Excellence, collaborating with peers across Finance, HR, and other functions to drive connected planning at scale.

### **Rewards and Benefits**


We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

jobs.description:
**Cisco Networking Group**
**Meet the team**
 Cisco's Networking (CN) organization is one that builds on the wonderful history of Cisco inventing and leading the global networking industry. The opportunity in front of all of us is unbelievable. Networks around the globe have been growing for over 35 years, and we are still at the beginning! It’s hard to imagine that three billion of the world’s eight billion people are still unconnected or underserved. Soon enough, we will move from billions of connected things and people to trillions of connected things and people. With the rise of the public cloud, connectivity is no longer simply physical access but includes virtual connectivity. And all this connectivity is central to every experience and every economy around the world. Cisco has been synonymous with connectivity for the last 35 years, and we are excited about creating the next era of connectivity with you.
   

  

 One of the things that stands out to me is the amount of amazing innovation and passion in every single team. We build great products with employees who have a deep passion for winning and want to help our customers solve their greatest connectivity challenges.
   

  

 Cisco has always had great innovation, but in the past this innovation and our potential have often been hindered by organizational and product silos. By bringing our teams closer, centralizing and synchronizing our operations, we will accelerate innovation to enable our customers to simplify everything! Central Operations is a new business unit within Cisco’s Networking organization who has been tasked to centralizing our practices as a service across. Our mission is to transform Cisco’s operational efficiencies by using real time data and insights and synchronized business processes to drive business decisions and accelerate the delivery of our strategic agendas. This will enable our vision, which is to increase both the human and cost efficiencies within Cisco, that will enable faster execution of our employees as well as free up capital that will allow us to afford resources earlier than would have been expected. The result is increased Operational Leverage generated by increased operating income, profit, and revenues for Cisco. You would be joining the Networking team, and the Central Operations organization to fulfill this mission and vision.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 As a Business Analyst, you will be responsible for the end\-to\-end management of processes surrounding the commitment of funds within Cisco. You’ll need to understand the policies within Cisco which instruct and require certain aspects of the funding request to be fulfilled and execute to those policies. You will also be responsible for entering each funding request, following them through the approval process, and helping to answer any questions or modify the entry as required. This general approach to managing the commitment of funds extends to our cross\-charge functions, as well as our accrual processes. With this responsibility, you will be working intimately with our Business Units across CN and with our partner organizations such as Finance, and Procurement – GSM and GPS \& Security Compliance orgs. We are looking for an experienced order fulfillment individual to drive more effective funds commitment and management processes within the business. When there is a roadblock working with other partner organizations, it’s your job to assist. We fulfill each above function by working within our own internally developed Business Operations Command Center Toolset while providing our organization the necessary training, documented procedures, operations, and tools to succeed. You would support many of these activities in support of your team.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 We are looking for someone who understands the purchasing systems and policies necessary to fulfil purchasing commitments with ease. Someone who makes perfect sense out of every field in SmartBuy, iProcurement, FinABC, GPE/BATS, Fieldglass, CCW and other purchasing and cross charge systems. You have been doing this for years, and desire to begin working more closely with the business units.
   

  

 We need you if you have a strong interest and experience in business operational practices and can assist in executing processes in a uniform fashion across CN. The processes and systems you will be maintaining will report and analyze intelligence metrics that will set, monitor, and drive improved financial results across CN. It is imperative that the information we enter and the contracts we submit for funding approval be aligned to policy. It’s our job to create efficiencies through quality work products. You will be responsible for reviewing, learning, maintaining, implementing, and improving systems and processes that help the organization scale and run more efficiently. You are a self\-starter; able to create a look forward and clear potential issues before they become roadblocks.
   

  

 You achieve success through strong cross\-functional relationships, engaging coworkers, and stakeholders to jointly design and deliver what an individual team could not. You also have a great passion for quality in your execution, you have great attention to detail, and you focus easily to drive tactical tasks to completion. You understand the needs of your cross\-functional stakeholders and customers. You measure success in the impact of your programs and breadth of cross\-functional contribution. This role is highly collaborative with tactical daily requirements. We will work with many organizations to deliver value to our business unit as well as across the Cisco Enterprise Networking group.
   

  

 You should have a strong understanding of Cisco systems used to execute our Procurement process, a general understanding of budget management, a tenacious desire to help people become more efficient. You value tactical and operational duties and have no issues spending cycles perform…

If you too want to be directly involved, grow in a stimulating and caring environment, feel useful on a daily basis and develop or strengthen your expertise, you will feel right at home with us!
   

  

 Still hesitating?
   

  

 You should know that our employees can dedicate several days per year to solidarity actions during their working hours, including sponsoring people struggling with their orientation or professional integration, participating in the financial education of young apprentices, and sharing their skills with charities. There are many ways to get involved.
   

  

 We are committed to support accelerating our Group’s ESG strategy by implementing ESG principles in all our activities and policies. They are translated in our business activity (ESG assessment, reporting, project management or IT activities), our work environment and in our responsible practices for environment protection.

jobs.description:
**About The Job**
**About Zamp :**
**Mission**
 Zamp is not a company, were a humanity catalyst. Were on a mission to enable people to move at the speed of thought.
   

  

 This decade, were focused on building digital employees for the future of work, unlocking human creativity at a scale the world has never seen. We work with 50\+ top global organizations and banks (including DoorDash, Uber, and Stripe) with billions in revenue. We raised a $22M seed round in 2022 from Sequoia Capital, Dara Khosrowshahi (CEO, Uber), Tony Xu (CEO, DoorDash), and other global leaders.
   

  

 One aspect of our purpose is to build what we believe to be the worlds best team, passionate, authentic, and relentlessly curious people who want to do their lifes best work, learn as much as possible, and create outsized impact.
   

  

 Hear more from the founders here.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As an AI Solution Analyst \- AI Workflows at Zamp.ai, you will operate as a key business partner on the front line. Your primary focus is to deeply understand customer processes, capture workflow requirements, and translate them into precise, high\-quality AI workflows on our platform using our code generation platform.
   

  

 You will collaborate with internal teams and customers to unpack real operational challenges, formalise problem statements, and ensure the workflows created truly reflect business needs. The role is rooted in business analysis, process understanding, and structured problem\-solving, with a strong emphasis on clarity, accuracy, and customer impact.
   

  

 At its core, this is a business\-driven role that leverages AI to transform customer operations into reliable, measurable, and scalable workflows.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Workflow Definition \& Implementation : Translate customer and internal business process requirements into workflow specifications, then use our internal AI tooling to generate code and assemble workflow logic and automation.
* End\-to\-End Ownership : Validate workflows end\-to\-end \- from design through testing, to production rollout and performance monitoring.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration : Serve as the critical link between business teams, product \& engineering. Provide feedback on workflow patterns, tool improvement and platform capabilities.
* Customer \& Stakeholder Enablement : Work with customer\-facing teams to onboard workflow solutions, ensure they run smoothly, and support adoption and feedback\-loops.
* Business Impact Tracking : Monitor workflow performance, measure KPIs/ROI, communicate value and insights to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.


**Qualifications**
* 5 \- 8 years of professional experience in business/analyst roles or equivalent.
* Strong academic foundation; candidates from top\-tier institutes (IITs and other premier colleges) preferred.
* Undergraduate degree in Computer Science (or equivalent) strongly preferred, with proficiency in basic programming (e.g., Python, JavaScript) and a passion for building solutions.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills, clarity of thought, and structured approach to workflow or process modelling.
* Initiative and ownership mindset : you thrive in fast\-moving, ambiguous environments and proactively drive results.
* Strong communication skills and customer orientation : you can translate business needs into technical/solution language and interact effectively across teams.


**Our Culture \& Benefits**
 At Zamp.ai, we foster a culture of transparency, meritocracy, and empowerment. Join a lean, high\-velocity team where your impact is visible, your work matters, and youll grow quickly.
   

  

**Perks Include**
* Competitive salary \+ stock options with upside.
* Collaborative environment working with top\-tier talent.
* Inclusive and diverse workspace.
* Comprehensive medical insurance for employees, spouse and dependents.
* Continuous learning and development opportunities.
* Office with comfortable work setting and excellent amenities.

jobs.title: Change Management Analyst
jobs.description:
**Team Description**
 We are looking for someone who is passionate about helping people adapt to change and adopt new ways of working. In this role, you will play a key part in driving organizational change initiatives related to AI tools, automation, and ServiceNow (SNOW) workflows. You will use data and employee feedback to understand adoption trends, identify barriers to change, and develop strategies that help teams successfully transition to new processes and technologies.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone with a Business Analyst or Change Management mindset who enjoys working at the intersection of people, process, and technology. You will help ensure that new solutions are not only implemented but embraced and effectively used across the organization.
   

  

**Role And Responsibilities**
**Support Change Initiatives:** 
 Partner with different teams to plan and execute change management activities that drive successful adoption of new technologies, processes, and ways of working.
   

  

**Analyze Business Processes:** 
 Assess current workflows and identify opportunities to improve efficiency through AI, automation, and process optimization.
   

  

**Measure Adoption and Engagement:** 
 Develop and analyze adoption metrics, dashboards, and reports to understand user engagement and identify areas requiring additional support.
   

  

**Stakeholder Engagement:** 
 Work with business teams, managers, and project stakeholders to understand concerns, gather feedback, and ensure organizational readiness for change.
   

  

**ServiceNow \& Process Support:** 
 Utilize ServiceNow (SNOW) to support workflow improvements, track implementation activities, and gather insights into process performance.
   

  

**Training and Enablement:** 
 Create user guides, training materials, and communication plans that help employees understand and adopt new tools and processes.
   

  

**Change Communications:** 
 Develop clear and compelling communications that explain the purpose, benefits, and impact of organizational changes.
   

  

**Continuous Improvement:** 
 Monitor adoption outcomes, collect feedback, and recommend improvements to enhance user experience and long\-term sustainability.
   

  

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** 
 Partner with project managers, technical teams, and business leaders to align change management activities with project objectives and timelines.
   

  

**Qualifications And Education Requirements**
* Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Experience supporting organizational change, technology adoption, process improvement, training, or business analysis initiatives.
* Experience or comfort working with ServiceNow (SNOW), including reviewing workflows, tracking requests, and generating reports.
* Ability to analyze data and trends using tools such as Excel or reporting platforms to measure adoption and identify improvement opportunities.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts in a clear and relatable manner.
* Interest in AI, automation, and emerging technologies, with enthusiasm for helping others adopt new solutions.
* Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Demonstrated ability to influence and drive change through collaboration rather than authority.


**Nice To Have Qualifications**
* Familiarity with formal change management methodologies
* Experience supporting technology transformation, digital adoption, or process improvement initiatives.
* Experience creating training materials, adoption campaigns, or employee communications.
* Knowledge of ServiceNow workflows and reporting capabilities.
* Exposure to AI\-enabled tools and enterprise automation platforms.
